item.title: hello yes am april 1
item.content:encoded:
Hello everyone, djkaktus here. This is a fun article a few people and I put together over the last few weeks/months. Aside from all the contributing authors here, I'd also like to thank Woedenaz for another absolute banger of a site theme for this bad boy. You are the bee's knees, Woed.

This is a collaborative article. Feel free to add recipes to the list - the more they act as an actual recipe the better, but there's definitely room for some laughs and jocularity in here as well. I'll keep an eye on this and prune any that aren't up to snuff. If you have any questions about formatting, check the other entries!

Thanks again to all the contributors. Happy April 1st!
